title: Pullback of scalar Ext for a Koszul-regular immersion
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes, locally generated near every point of $Z$ by a finite Koszul-regular sequence. Use the scheme, ideal, module pullback, derived category and internal Hom of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Let $C=i^*\mathcal I$, $N=\mathcal Hom(C,\mathcal O_Z)$ and let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant and equal to the stalk finrank of $C$, using [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every integer $q \geq 0$, $i^*H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))\cong T^q$, where $T^q$ is the degree-$q$ term of [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex] applied to $N,r$: it is the direct image of $\bigwedge^q(N|_{\{r=q\}})$ from the clopen rank-$q$ stratum for $q\geq0$. This asserts only sheaf isomorphisms, not an isomorphism of derived objects. This only asserts an isomorphism on Z and does not reconstruct the ambient sheaf.

proof.text: For the clopen rank-q stratum V, use hr and membership in V to compute the conormal finrank as q.toNat. Apply the constant-rank top Ext comparison with the restriction of hregular to V. Nonnegativity identifies the integer degree q.toNat with q.

The rank-support theorem identifies the whole pulled-back Ext sheaf with the pushforward of its restriction to V, via the open adjunction unit. Push forward the top-degree determinant isomorphism from the first step and compose with this support isomorphism. Unfold locallyRankedExteriorTerm in the nonnegative case to identify the result with the unchanged conclusion.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_ext_pullback
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    {q : ℤ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    let F : Y.Modules := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj
          (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))),
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm
      (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
        (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r q))
